author: kavanaghgareth
title: Paid Artist Open Call for Paradise Towers 2 Backup Strips
content: Paid artist open call out! Yes, we're looking for new artists for the backup strips on Paradise Towers 2, out this February. Build high for happiness! Contact: DM @kavanaghgareth or email portfolio (as indicated in comments; check @cutawaycomics for full details).

author: young.onion
title: Hiring Kawaii Artists for Stationery Collection
content: 🎨 WE ARE HIRING KAWAII ARTISTS! ✨🐾 Calling all creators of all things cute, pastel, and absolutely adorable! 🥰 We are on the lookout for talented artists to bring their kawaii magic to our upcoming stationery collection! 📓✍️💖 If you love drawing chubby characters, happy little stationery, and sweet pastel doodles, we want to see your work! From journals and stickers to washi tapes and pens, let’s make something magical together. ✨ How to apply: 1️⃣ Make sure you're following us [@young.onion]! 2️⃣ Drop a comment below with your favorite emoji and tag an artist friend who needs to see this! 👇 3️⃣ Send us a DM with a link to your portfolio or fill out the application form in our bio! 📂✨ You can also mail us info@youngonion.in Can't wait to see your cute art! Let’s create something amazing! 🌸💫

author: philfalcowrites
title: Paid Comic Work for TRANSPHORIA Anthology
content: PAID COMIC WORK: Apply to be a Writer or Artist in the next volume of Ringo Award-winning comic anthology: TRANSPHORIA! No previous experience required (we love working with industry veterans AND fresh faces). Absolutely no costs to apply/contribute. Paid work for accepted contributors. Creators retain rights to their stories! Application Deadline: December 21, 2026! Link in @philfalcowrites bio! Contact via application link in bio.
